_about: Tokyo stays where the room is the point. Each hotel's feature was checked on its official site where reachable, and the room-type name on Booking.com on 'checked'. 'pick' is the exact Booking.com room-type wording. A Booking.com button appears only once the hotel's affiliate link is issued (data/booking-hotel-urls.json). No prices: they change by date.
title: Unique Tokyo Hotels: Skytree & Tokyo Tower Views, Pokémon and Godzilla Rooms
description: Eleven Tokyo hotels where the room is the point: Skytree and Tokyo Tower views, Pokémon, Godzilla and dinosaur rooms, artist-painted rooms. With the exact room type to pick when you book.
h1: Tokyo hotels where the room is the reason to go
lead: Wake up facing Skytree, sleep next to Godzilla, or give the kids a Pokémon Room. Each of these hotels also sells ordinary rooms, so we tell you the exact room type to pick.
disclosure: PR: We may earn a commission if you book through these Booking.com links, at no extra cost to you.

rule.title: The one thing to get right
rule.text: Booking the hotel isn't enough. Our Booking.com links open a search with the hotel at the top: tap the hotel, then choose the room type with the name we give. Other rooms at the same hotel are regular rooms, and a view or theme can't be added at check-in.

sections.title: Tokyo Skytree views
sections.intro: Skytree is east of central Tokyo, so these hotels are in Asakusa, Oshiage and Kinshicho, and the view room is a specific side of the building.

hotels.name: Asakusa View Hotel
hotels.what: An Asakusa hotel with a Sky Tree View Side looking over Skytree and the old streets below. Some rooms have a bathtub with the view.
hotels.suits: Couples and first-timers who want Asakusa on the doorstep.
hotels.pick: Room types ending “with Skytree Side”, e.g. Superior Twin with Skytree Side. For the bath view: Executive Deluxe King with View Bath and Skytree Side.
hotels.guarantee: Only room types with “Skytree Side” in the name face the tower.

hotels.name: Tobu Hotel Levant Tokyo
hotels.area: Kinshicho, 3 min from JR Kinshicho Station
hotels.what: A Kinshicho hotel with rooms that look straight at Skytree.
hotels.suits: Travelers who want the view next to a JR station.
hotels.pick: Room types with “with Tokyo Sky Tree View”. Types marked “No Tower View” face away.
hotels.guarantee: Only “with Tokyo Sky Tree View” room types face the tower; “No Tower View” types don't.

hotels.name: Keisei Richmond Hotel Tokyo Oshiage
hotels.area: Oshiage, at the foot of Skytree
hotels.what: A hotel in Oshiage, the neighborhood at the foot of Skytree.
hotels.suits: Anyone who wants Skytree up close.
hotels.pick: Room types starting “(Skytree View)”, e.g. (Skytree View) Comfort Double Room.
hotels.note: We could not open the hotel's official site; the room names are as Booking.com lists them.
hotels.guarantee: Only room types starting “(Skytree View)” face the tower.

hotels.name: Hotel East 21 Tokyo
hotels.what: A hotel in Toyocho with family rooms that face Skytree.
hotels.suits: Families: the Skytree family rooms take up to 4 adults.
hotels.pick: “Deluxe Family Room with Sky Tree View” (2, 3 or 4 adults) or “King Room with Skytree View”.
hotels.note: The hotel's official site was under maintenance when we checked; the room names are as Booking.com lists them.
hotels.guarantee: Only room types with “Sky Tree View” in the name face the tower.

sections.title: Tokyo Tower views
sections.intro: Tokyo Tower is in Minato, so the view rooms are in Shiba Park, Shiodome and Toranomon.

hotels.name: The Prince Park Tower Tokyo
hotels.what: A hotel in Shiba Park that sells rooms by view, from standard twins to panoramic rooms on floors 19–28.
hotels.suits: The widest choice of Tokyo Tower rooms, including some for 3–4 guests with extra beds.
hotels.pick: Any type ending “with Tokyo Tower View”. “Panoramic” on its own means a high floor, not the tower.
hotels.guarantee: Only room types ending “with Tokyo Tower View” face the tower.

hotels.name: Park Hotel Tokyo
hotels.what: Rooms on floors 26–34 of a Shiodome tower. Tokyo Tower Side rooms face the tower; Artist Rooms are painted by artists (see below).
hotels.suits: Couples and solo travelers; rooms are 19–33 m².
hotels.pick: “Twin Room Tokyo Tower Side”, “Queen Room Tokyo Tower Side” or “Corner King Room Tokyo Tower Side”.
hotels.guarantee: Only “Tokyo Tower Side” room types face the tower.

hotels.name: The Tokyo EDITION, Toranomon
hotels.what: A hotel in Toranomon, in the same part of Minato as Tokyo Tower.
hotels.pick: “Premier Tower View King”, which Booking.com lists with a Tokyo Tower view. The “Deluxe Tower View King” is listed with a city view.
hotels.note: The official site blocked our check; the room names are as Booking.com lists them.
hotels.guarantee: Booking.com lists the Tokyo Tower view only for the Premier Tower View King.

sections.title: Pokémon, Godzilla and dinosaur rooms
sections.intro: Themed rooms are few and sell out first. The theme belongs to the room type, not the hotel.

hotels.name: MIMARU Pokémon Rooms
hotels.area: Five Tokyo hotels: Ueno East, Ikebukuro, Kinshicho, Ginza East, Hatchobori
hotels.what: Pokémon Rooms with a giant Snorlax on the bed, a Poké Ball dining table and Pokémon kitchenware. One gift set per booking.
hotels.suits: Families: 4–6 guests, 38–60 m², kitchen in every room. Layout (loft, bunk beds or four singles) depends on the hotel.
hotels.pick: “Pokémon ROOM”. The other apartments are regular rooms, and the room design can't be chosen.
hotels.guarantee: Only the “Pokémon ROOM” type. Five Tokyo locations; the design can't be chosen.

hotels.name: Hotel Gracery Shinjuku
hotels.area: Shinjuku, 5 min from JR Shinjuku Station (East Exit)
hotels.what: The hotel with the giant Godzilla head. The top (30th) floor is a 35-room Godzilla Floor; there is also a single Godzilla Room and six Godzilla View Rooms.
hotels.suits: Godzilla and movie fans who want to be in the middle of Shinjuku.
hotels.pick: On Booking.com: “Standard Twin on the Highest Floor (Godzilla Floor)”.
hotels.note: The one Godzilla Room and the Godzilla View Rooms are booked on the hotel's own site; we didn't see them on Booking.com.
hotels.guarantee: The Godzilla Floor is guaranteed only with this room type. The single Godzilla Room isn't on Booking.com.

hotels.name: Henn na Hotel Tokyo Nishikasai
hotels.area: Nishikasai, 3 min from Nishi-kasai Station (Tokyo Metro Tozai Line)
hotels.what: Robot dinosaurs run check-in, and two Dinosaur Rooms sleep up to 3 adults. The hotel runs a free daily bus toward Tokyo Disney Resort.
hotels.suits: Families with dinosaur fans, especially on a Disney trip.
official: Henn na Hotel Tokyo Nishikasai (official, Japanese)
hotels.guarantee: The dinosaur theme comes only with this room type, and there are two such rooms.

sections.title: Art rooms and view baths
sections.intro: Rooms where the design itself is the experience.

hotels.name: Park Hotel Tokyo — Artist Rooms
hotels.what: More than 50 rooms, each painted directly onto the walls by a different artist.
hotels.suits: Art lovers and repeat visitors to Tokyo.
hotels.pick: “Artist Queen Room”, “Artist King Room” or “Artist Single Room”. The artwork is assigned at check-in; you can list up to three you'd like.
hotels.guarantee: Artist rooms only; the artwork is assigned at check-in.

hotels.name: Mitsui Garden Hotel Ginza Premier
hotels.what: A Ginza hotel with a 16th-floor lobby looking over the city, and rooms with a View Bath.
hotels.suits: Couples who want Ginza and a bath with a view.
hotels.pick: “Superior Queen Room with View Bath” or “Deluxe Twin Room with View Bath”.
hotels.guarantee: Only room types “with View Bath” come with the view bath.
